title: The k Strongest Values in an Array
description: Find the k strongest values in an array based on distance from the median.
pseudocode:
1. sort(arr)
2. median = arr[(n-1)/2]
3. left = 0, right = n-1
4. result = []
5. while k > 0:
6. if abs(arr[left] - median) > abs(arr[right] - median):
7. result.push(arr[left++])
8. else:
9. result.push(arr[right--])
10. k--

steps.note: Compare dist(1, 3)=2 vs dist(5, 3)=2. Since 2 is not > 2, pick right element.
Add 5 to result, decrement right pointer
Compare dist(1, 3)=2 vs dist(4, 3)=1. 2 > 1, pick left element.
Add 1 to result, increment left pointer
